findings.title: Pod waits for a scheduler that is not running
findings.cause: the pod asks for scheduler volcano and no scheduler has looked at it in 5m0s; volcano is not running, or does not handle this namespace; Deployment web has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.what: pod asks for scheduler volcano and has no PodScheduled condition

evidence.command: kubectl get pods -A -o wide | grep -i sched

findings.fix: Install or start volcano (and check its logs and the namespaces it watches), or remove schedulerName to use the default scheduler.
